natural: Too small to be worth mentioning

meaning.en: Insignificant; trivial; not worth mentioning.
meaning.zh: 非常渺小，不值得一提。

examples.zh: 跟大家的付出比，我做的这点事微不足道。
examples.en: Compared with what everyone else put in, my bit is nothing worth mentioning.

examples.zh: 一个人的力量虽然微不足道，但团结起来就很强大。
examples.en: One person's strength may be insignificant, but together we are strong.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Often used modestly about one's own contribution.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常用作自谦。

natural: The benefit received is far from slight

meaning.en: To benefit greatly; to learn a lot from something.
meaning.zh: 得到的好处很多。

examples.zh: 听了王教授的讲座，我受益匪浅。
examples.en: I learned a great deal from Professor Wang's lecture.

examples.zh: 这次实习让我受益匪浅，学到了很多书本上没有的东西。
examples.en: I got a lot out of this internship and learned much that isn't in textbooks.

usage.en: Predicate. Formal and polite; common in thank-you notes and essays. 匪 = 非 (not).
usage.zh: 多作谓语。书面、客气，常见于致谢和作文。"匪"同"非"。

natural: Sitting high up above everyone

meaning.en: Aloof and out of touch with ordinary people; lording it over others.
meaning.zh: 原指地位高，现多形容领导脱离实际、脱离群众。

examples.zh: 领导不能高高在上，要多到基层看看。
examples.en: Leaders shouldn't sit in ivory towers — they should go and see the grassroots.

examples.zh: 她说话总是一副高高在上的样子。
examples.en: She always talks in a high-and-mighty way.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Usually criticises officials, bosses or arrogant people.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，多批评领导或傲慢的人。

natural: Weigh your strength, then act

meaning.en: To act according to one's abilities or means; not to overreach.
meaning.zh: 按照自己力量的大小去做。

equivalents: cut your coat according to your cloth
don't bite off more than you can chew

examples.zh: 捐款要量力而行，不必勉强。
examples.en: Donate according to your means — no need to stretch yourself.

examples.zh: 刚开始健身要量力而行，以免受伤。
examples.en: When you start working out, know your limits so you don't get injured.

usage.en: Predicate. Often used as advice.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用来劝告。

natural: Eyes wide open and nerve on display

meaning.en: Brazenly; openly doing something wrong without fear.
meaning.zh: 公开地、毫无顾忌地做坏事。

examples.zh: 小偷竟敢明目张胆地在大街上抢包。
examples.en: The thief brazenly snatched a bag in the middle of the street.

examples.zh: 这家公司明目张胆地抄袭别人的设计。
examples.en: The company flagrantly copied other people's designs.

usage.en: Adverbial (明目张胆地) or predicate. Derogatory today; originally could mean acting boldly and openly.
usage.zh: 多作状语、谓语。现为贬义，原指有胆识、敢作敢为。

natural: Chain reaction

meaning.en: A chain reaction; one event setting off a series of others.
meaning.zh: 原指化学、核物理中的链式反应，比喻相关的事物接连发生变化。

examples.zh: 一家大银行倒闭，可能引发连锁反应。
examples.en: The collapse of one big bank could set off a chain reaction.

examples.zh: 油价上涨带来了一系列连锁反应。
examples.en: The rise in oil prices had a series of knock-on effects.

usage.en: Borrowed from science (chain reaction), 20th century. Object of 引起/引发/产生.
usage.zh: 借自科学术语"链式反应"，二十世纪出现。常作"引起、引发、产生"的宾语。

natural: End up with exactly the opposite

meaning.en: To produce the opposite of the intended result; to backfire.
meaning.zh: 恰恰得到相反的结果。

examples.zh: 父母管得太严，往往适得其反。
examples.en: When parents are too strict, it often backfires.

examples.zh: 过度宣传反而适得其反，让顾客产生反感。
examples.en: Over-the-top advertising had the opposite effect and put customers off.

usage.en: Predicate. Often with 往往、反而、只会.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与"往往、反而、只会"搭配。

natural: Gather all one's energy and attention

meaning.en: To concentrate fully; with rapt attention.
meaning.zh: 集中精神，集中注意力。

examples.zh: 同学们聚精会神地听老师讲故事。
examples.en: The pupils listened to the teacher's story with rapt attention.

examples.zh: 他聚精会神地盯着电脑屏幕，连有人叫他都没听见。
examples.en: He was so absorbed in the screen that he didn't hear someone call him.

story.en: Wang Bao's ode on a wise ruler finding able ministers describes them working together, "gathering their essence and assembling their spirit" (聚精会神) in harmony.
story.zh: 西汉王褒《圣主得贤臣颂》中有"聚精会神，相得益章"之句。

usage.en: Usually adverbial (聚精会神地看/听). Very common in school writing.
usage.zh: 多作状语，如"聚精会神地看/听"。作文常用。

natural: Carry on the past and open the way for the future

meaning.en: To link past and future; to inherit from predecessors and pave the way for successors.
meaning.zh: 承接前面的，开创后面的。多指学问、事业、时代的继承和发展。

examples.zh: 这次会议在公司发展史上具有承前启后的意义。
examples.en: This meeting is a bridge between past and future in the company's history.

examples.zh: 这一段在文章中起承前启后的作用。
examples.en: This paragraph links what comes before it with what follows.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate. Common in history writing and in analysing essay structure (起承前启后的作用). For paragraphs in an essay, the related 承上启下 is more usual.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语。常用于历史和文章结构分析，分析段落时也说"承上启下"。

natural: Generously open one's purse

meaning.en: To give generously, especially money to help others.
meaning.zh: 毫不吝惜地拿出钱财帮助别人。

equivalents: put one's hand in one's pocket

examples.zh: 地震发生后，各界人士慷慨解囊，支援灾区。
examples.en: After the earthquake, people from all walks of life dug deep to help the disaster area.

examples.zh: 听说同事家里有困难，大家纷纷慷慨解囊。
examples.en: Hearing a colleague's family was struggling, everyone gave generously.

usage.en: Predicate. Common in news about donations and charity.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常见于捐款、慈善报道。

natural: Able to bear hardship and hard work

meaning.en: Able to endure hardship and work hard.
meaning.zh: 能吃苦，能经受劳累。

equivalents: willing to roll up one's sleeves

examples.zh: 他从农村来，特别能吃苦耐劳。
examples.en: He grew up in the countryside and is incredibly hard-working and tough.

examples.zh: 招聘要求：有责任心，吃苦耐劳。
examples.en: Job requirements: responsible, hard-working and resilient.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. A staple of job ads and character references.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，招聘启事和评语中常见。

natural: Racing to be first, afraid of being last

meaning.en: To scramble to be first; everyone rushing forward at once.
meaning.zh: 争着向前，唯恐落后。

examples.zh: 老师一提问，同学们争先恐后地举手。
examples.en: As soon as the teacher asked a question, the pupils raced to put their hands up.

examples.zh: 商场一开门，顾客就争先恐后地涌了进去。
examples.en: The moment the mall opened, shoppers jostled their way in.

usage.en: Usually adverbial (争先恐后地). Positive when it shows eagerness, negative when it describes pushing and shoving.
usage.zh: 多作状语。可表积极踊跃，也可指拥挤争抢。

natural: So frightened one doesn't know what to do

meaning.en: Panic-stricken; so alarmed that one loses one's head.
meaning.zh: 由于惊慌，一下子不知怎么办才好。

equivalents: run around like a headless chicken

examples.zh: 火警响起时，他一点也没有惊慌失措。
examples.en: When the fire alarm went off, he didn't panic at all.

examples.zh: 面对突发情况，惊慌失措只会让事情更糟。
examples.en: Losing your head in an emergency only makes things worse.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial. Often negated as advice: 不要惊慌失措.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，常用否定"不要惊慌失措"。

natural: With one heart and one mind

meaning.en: Wholeheartedly; with undivided attention or loyalty.
meaning.zh: 只有一个心眼儿，没有别的考虑。形容专心专意。

examples.zh: 他一心一意想把公司做好。
examples.en: He is single-mindedly determined to make the company a success.

examples.zh: 结婚以后，两个人要一心一意地过日子。
examples.en: After marriage, a couple should be wholeheartedly devoted to their life together.

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate. Used for work, study and loyalty in relationships. In speech: yì xīn yí yì (tone sandhi).
usage.zh: 多作状语、谓语。口语变调读 yì xīn yí yì。

natural: One stroke with three turns

meaning.en: Full of twists and turns; with many setbacks along the way.
meaning.zh: 原指写字笔画曲折多姿，后比喻事情进行中意外变化很多。

examples.zh: 这次签证申请一波三折，最后总算办下来了。
examples.en: The visa application had all kinds of twists and turns, but it finally came through.

examples.zh: 这部电影情节一波三折，非常吸引人。
examples.en: The film's plot is full of twists and turns and really gripping.

origin.source: 晋·王羲之《题卫夫人笔阵图后》

story.en: The calligrapher Wang Xizhi advised that "in every sweeping stroke (波), turn the brush three times" (每作一波，常三过折笔), making the line lively.
story.zh: 王羲之论书法："每作一波，常三过折笔。"指笔画曲折多姿。

usage.en: Predicate. Used for processes, plots and experiences. Not the same as 一石三鸟.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，形容过程、情节、经历曲折。

natural: Lingering and forgetting to go home

meaning.en: To enjoy a place so much that one forgets to leave.
meaning.zh: 留恋美好的景物，舍不得离开。

examples.zh: 西湖的美景让游客流连忘返。
examples.en: The scenery of West Lake is so lovely that visitors never want to leave.

examples.zh: 这家书店让人流连忘返，一待就是一下午。
examples.en: This bookshop is so enchanting you can spend a whole afternoon there.

story.en: Mencius explains that drifting downstream and forgetting to return is called 流, and drifting upstream and forgetting to return is called 连, warning rulers against endless pleasure trips.
story.zh: 《孟子》："从流下而忘反谓之流，从流上而忘反谓之连。"原批评君王游乐无度。

usage.en: Predicate, often 让人/令人流连忘返. Now positive, about scenery and places; the original was critical.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用"令人流连忘返"。现为褒义，原有批评意味。

natural: Put it aside and pay it no attention

meaning.en: To ignore; to leave something unattended.
meaning.zh: 放在一边，不理不睬。

examples.zh: 顾客的投诉不能置之不理。
examples.en: Customer complaints can't just be ignored.

examples.zh: 他牙疼了好几天都置之不理，结果越来越严重。
examples.en: He ignored his toothache for days, and it got worse and worse.

usage.en: Predicate, often 对……置之不理. Often negated as a duty: 不能置之不理.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用"对……置之不理"、"不能置之不理"。

natural: Same aims, same path

meaning.en: Like-minded; sharing the same goals and ideals.
meaning.zh: 志向相同，意见一致。

examples.zh: 他和几个志同道合的朋友一起创办了公司。
examples.en: He started the company with a few like-minded friends.

examples.zh: 在读书会上，她找到了一群志同道合的人。
examples.en: At the book club she found a group of kindred spirits.

usage.en: Attributive (志同道合的朋友) or predicate. Positive, unlike 臭味相投 which is derogatory.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语。褒义，与贬义的"臭味相投"不同。

natural: Where water flows, a channel forms

meaning.en: When conditions are right, success follows naturally.
meaning.zh: 水流到的地方自然形成渠道。比喻条件成熟，事情自然会成功。

examples.zh: 基础打好了，提高成绩就是水到渠成的事。
examples.en: Once the foundations are solid, better grades will follow naturally.

examples.zh: 两人交往多年，结婚是水到渠成。
examples.en: After years together, marriage was the natural next step.

story.en: Su Shi, living frugally in exile, wrote that when his savings ran out he would make other plans: "when the water arrives, the channel forms — no need to worry in advance" (水到渠成，不须预虑).
story.zh: 苏轼贬居黄州时写道："至时别作经画，水到渠成，不须预虑。"

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (水到渠成的事). Stresses patience and preparation.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，如"水到渠成的事"。强调条件成熟。

natural: Adding flowers to embroidered silk

meaning.en: To make something good even better; the icing on the cake.
meaning.zh: 在锦上再绣花。比喻好上加好，美上添美。

examples.zh: 这道菜已经很好吃了，再加点香菜就是锦上添花。
examples.en: This dish is already delicious — a bit of coriander would be the icing on the cake.

examples.zh: 人们常说，锦上添花易，雪中送炭难。
examples.en: People often say it's easy to add icing to the cake but hard to bring charcoal in the snow.

story.en: Wang Anshi's poem speaks of a fine song that "adds flowers to brocade" (丽唱仍添锦上花) at a feast.
story.zh: 王安石《即事》："嘉招欲覆杯中渌，丽唱仍添锦上花。"

usage.en: Predicate or object. Often contrasted with 雪中送炭 (help when it is really needed).
usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语，常与"雪中送炭"对比。

literal: push away · old · bring out · new
natural: Clear out the old to bring out the new

meaning.en: To innovate by weeding out the old and developing the new, often building on tradition.
meaning.zh: 去掉旧事物的糟粕，取其精华，并发展出新的东西。

equivalents: out with the old, in with the new

examples.zh: 传统京剧也要推陈出新，才能吸引年轻观众。
examples.en: Traditional Peking opera needs to reinvent itself to attract young audiences.

examples.zh: 这家餐厅不断推陈出新，每个季节都有新菜。
examples.en: The restaurant keeps innovating, with new dishes every season.

usage.en: Predicate. Common in arts, culture and business; implies building on what is good in the old.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用于文艺、文化和商业。

natural: Of no help to the matter

meaning.en: Useless; to do no good; to make no difference.
meaning.zh: 对事情没有什么帮助。

examples.zh: 事情已经发生了，后悔也无济于事。
examples.en: It's already happened — regretting it won't help.

examples.zh: 光靠喊口号无济于事，要拿出实际行动。
examples.en: Shouting slogans is no use — we need real action.

usage.en: Predicate. Often after 也、都 (哭也无济于事).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与"也、都"连用。

natural: Unable to hold one's feelings back

meaning.en: Cannot help oneself; to be overcome by emotion.
meaning.zh: 感情激动得不能控制，不由自主。

examples.zh: 听到这个好消息，她情不自禁地笑了起来。
examples.en: Hearing the good news, she couldn't help laughing.

examples.zh: 音乐一响，大家情不自禁地跟着唱了起来。
examples.en: As soon as the music started, everyone couldn't help singing along.

usage.en: Usually adverbial (情不自禁地). For actions driven by emotion: laughing, crying, singing.
usage.zh: 多作状语，多用于笑、哭、唱等由情感引起的动作。

natural: Coming up with a design all one's own

meaning.en: Original; to come up with a new and unusual idea.
meaning.zh: 独创一格，与众不同。

examples.zh: 这家咖啡馆的装修别出心裁，墙上挂满了旧唱片。
examples.en: The café's décor is really original — the walls are covered with old records.

examples.zh: 他别出心裁地用诗歌的形式写了这份报告。
examples.en: He inventively wrote the report in the form of a poem.

usage.en: Predicate, attributive or adverbial. Usually praise; can hint at being odd for the sake of it.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语、状语。多为褒义，有时含标新立异之意。

natural: Bluff one's way past the checkpoint

meaning.en: To get through by deception; to scrape by on a bluff.
meaning.zh: 用欺骗的手段逃过检查或审核。

equivalents: pull the wool over someone's eyes

examples.zh: 他没复习，想靠作弊蒙混过关。
examples.en: He didn't revise and hoped to cheat his way through.

examples.zh: 产品质量不合格，别想蒙混过关。
examples.en: The product isn't up to standard — don't think you can slip it past the inspectors.

usage.en: Predicate. Often 想/别想蒙混过关. 蒙 is méng here.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用"想/别想蒙混过关"。"蒙"读 méng。
